g.text: 500 requested counterfactual annotations | 500 paired bootstrap draws per estimable cell
Table 2-style layout; local test uses per-draw squared errors
Two-sided paired t test of per-draw squared errors; unadjusted alpha = 0.05. Positive t favors DM+. Red: p >= 0.05 or t < 0.
Conditional test, 25 estimable cells: 13 significant improvements, 12 worsenings, 0 not significant.
APRIL reports paired RMSE distributions but does not disclose their construction; this table does not claim identical test inputs.
NE: no sodium dosage target-validation patients. Resamples are not 500 independent new patient cohorts.
